content: tauri-plugin-pty (v0.1.1, Jan 2026) wraps portable-pty ^0.9.0 internally. Requires Tauri ^2. JS API: spawn(command, args, {cols, rows}) returns pty object; pty.onData(data => ...) receives output; pty.write(data) sends input. Directly compatible with xterm.js onData/write pattern. Very early stage (22 stars), semi-documented. For production-quality pty in Tauri: implement directly with portable-pty + Channel API for more control. portable-pty 0.9.x: spawn command into a pty, get reader/writer pair, spawn async read loop, send chunks via Channel to frontend.
